verdict.rationale: Otter has a public pricing page listing tier features such as '3 lifetime audio/video file imports', 'Join 3 concurrent meetings', 'Otter API & Webhooks' and 'Enhanced admin features', and a community report mentions free users, so a free starting point and self-serve feature differentiation are implied. The evidence does not show actual prices or which features belong to which tier, so 'see exactly what each paid tier costs' is unproven. Missing for 10: published per-tier dollar prices, an explicit tier-by-tier feature mapping, explicit confirmation of a free plan, and confirmation that basic paid tiers are self-serve without contacting sales.

support.subject: As a founder, I can start free and see exactly what each paid tier costs and adds — no "talk to sales" wall for basic use

citations.quote: Enhanced admin features: activity logs, usage analytics, and more
Otter was not reviewing tickets from free users at the time
